channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Oliver Glasner oo dhaleeceeyay heerka Nottingham Forest, kuna baaqay in ciyaartoyda ay bartaan Ingiriisiga
item.description: Tababaraha Nottingham Forest Oliver Glasner ayaa 25 November sheegay in heerka kooxdu uusan ku filnayn markii uu yimid, isagoo su'aal ka keenay sababta qaar ka mid ah ciyaartoydiisu aysan ugu hadlin Ingiriisiga kadib sannado ay dalka joogeen.

item.title: PSG iyo Roma oo 2-2 ku kala tageen Paris, Malen oo rigoore ku soo celiyay barbarro
item.description: Paris Saint-Germain iyo Roma ayaa 25 November garoonka Parc des Princes ku kala tagay 2-2 kulankii shanaad ee wareegga horyaalka Champions League, iyadoo Donyell Malen uu rigoore ku dhaliyay goolka barbarraha daqiiqaddii 78-aad.

item.title: Florian Thauvin oo raali-gelin ka bixiyay wareysigii gaabnaa ee uu bixiyay kadib guuldarradii Lens
item.description: Kabtanka Lens Florian Thauvin ayaa 25 November raali-gelin ka bixiyay jawaabihii gaagaabnaa ee uu siiyay telefishinka Canal+, kadib markii kooxdiisa 3-1 looga adkaaday kulan Champions League ah oo ay la ciyaartay RB Leipzig.

item.title: Barcelona oo Baku 4-1 kaga adkaatay Sabah, Anthony Gordon oo laba gool dhaliyay
item.description: Barcelona ayaa 25 November garoonka Baku Olympic Stadium 4-1 kaga badiyay kooxda Sabah ee Azerbaijan, kulankii shanaad ee wareegga horyaalka Champions League, iyadoo Anthony Gordon uu dhaliyay laba gool.

item.title: NBA oo qorsheynaysa inay ugu yaraan 10 bilyan oo euro ku maalgaliso garoomada kubbadda koleyga ee Yurub
item.description: Ururka kubbadda koleyga ee Mareykanka NBA ayaa 25 November shaaciyay istaraatiijiyad lagu maalgalinayo ugu yaraan 10 bilyan oo euro horumarinta iyo dib-u-dhiska garoomada kubbadda koleyga ee qaaradda Yurub.

item.title: Salva Kiir oo amray in la ilaaliyo xorriyadda socodka musharixiinta ka hor ololaha doorashada Koonfur Suudaan
item.description: Madaxweynaha Koonfur Suudaan Salva Kiir ayaa 25 November amar ku siiyay ciidamada amniga iyo maamullada gobollada inay damaanad qaadaan xorriyadda socodka musharixiinta, kooxaha ololaha iyo muwaadiniinta inta lagu jiro ololaha doorashada soo socota.

item.title: Garsoorayaal Israa'iil ah oo soo jeediyay in la tuuro eedda laaluushka ee Netanyahu
item.description: Garsoorayaasha dhegaysanaya dacwadda musuqmaasuqa ee Ra'iisul Wasaaraha ku-meel-gaarka ah ee Israa'iil Benjamin Netanyahu ayaa 25 November xeer-ilaalinta u soo jeediyay inay ka noqoto mid ka mid ah eedaha laaluushka, iyagoo shaki geliyay labada kiis ee kale.

item.title: Liverpool oo 3-0 kaga adkaatay Club Brugge, Alexander Isak oo laba gool dhaliyay
item.description: Liverpool ayaa 25 November garoonka Jan Breydel ee Bruges 3-0 kaga adkaatay Club Brugge kulankii shanaad ee wareegga horyaalka Champions League, iyadoo Alexander Isak uu dhaliyay laba gool, Florian Wirtz-na mid.

item.title: Aaron Rodgers oo eedeymo culus u jeediyay tababaraha Steelers, kooxduna waxaa la sheegay inay sii deynayso
item.description: Aaron Rodgers ayaa 25 November si cad u dhaleeceeyay tababaraha Pittsburgh Steelers Mike McCarthy, isagoo ku eedeeyay inuu hurdo kulamada kooxda, maalin kadib markii kooxdu ka saartay liiska kulanka Jimcaha ee Denver Broncos.

item.title: Masar: Ugu yaraan 30 qof oo ku dhintay dab ka kacay waddada weyn ee ku wareegsan magaalada Qaahira
item.description: Dab ka kacay waddada weyn ee Ring Road oo ku wareegsan caasimadda Masar ee Qaahira ayaa 25 November dilay ugu yaraan 30 qof, sida ay sheegtay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Masar.

item.title: Horyaalka baseball-ka MLB oo maxkamad u qaaday ururka ciyaartoyda ka hor xiritaan la filayo
item.description: Horyaalka baseball-ka Mareykanka MLB ayaa 25 November dacwad ka gudbiyay maxkamadda federaalka ee Manhattan, isagoo ka dalbaday in xiritaanka (lockout) uu qorsheynayo toddobaadka soo socda loo aqoonsado mid sharci ah.

item.title: London Broncos oo dib ugu soo laabanaya Super League-ka rugby league sanadka 2027
item.description: Kooxda rugby league ee London Broncos ayaa la xaqiijiyay inay noqonayso kooxda 15-aad ee Super League-ka xilli ciyaareedka 2027, taas oo u noqonaysa markii ugu horreysay ee ay ku soo laabato heerka ugu sarreeya tan iyo 2024.

item.title: Maxkamadda Sare ee Ciraaq oo u ogolaatay dowladda federaalka inay la wareegto xuduudaha iyo kormeerka saliidda Kurdistan
item.description: Maxkamadda Sare ee Federaalka Ciraaq ayaa 25 November go'aamisay in ciidamada federaalku ay geli karaan xuduudaha caalamiga ah ee dalka oo dhan, oo ay ku jiraan kuwa gobolka Kurdistan ee is-maamula, isla markaana Wasaaradda Saliidda ay kormeeri karto beeraha saliidda iyo gaaska.

item.title: Wasiirka Gaadiidka oo ku baaqay in ciidamada laga saaro garoonka Beledweyne si duulimaadyada dib loogu bilaabo
item.description: Wasiirka Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada ee Soomaaliya, Maxamed Faarax Nuux, ayaa 25 November sheegay in dowladda federaalku aysan xayiraad rasmi ah saarin garoonka Ugaas Khaliif ee Beledweyne, wuxuuna ku baaqay in ciidamada hareeraha garoonka laga saaro.

item.title: Deni oo difaacay heshiisyada Imaaraadka, kuna eedeeyay Xasan Sheekh inuu khilaafka gudaha u beddelay mid dibadeed
item.description: Madaxweynaha Puntland Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa 25 November magaalada Gaalkacyo ka sheegay in Puntland ay sii wadi doonto heshiisyada ay la gashay Imaaraadka Carabta, wuxuuna ku eedeeyay madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud inuu khilaafka gudaha dalka ka dhigayo mid u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Imaaraadka.

item.title: Guddoomiyaha hay'adda nidaaminta kubadda Ingiriiska oo sheegay inay tallaabo ka qaadi karto milkiilayaasha Man City
item.description: David Kogan, guddoomiyaha Hay'adda Madaxa-bannaan ee Nidaaminta Kubadda Cagta Ingiriiska (IFR), ayaa 25 November guddi ka tirsan baarlamaanka Ingiriiska u sheegay in hay'addu ay qaadi doonto tallaabooyinka loo baahdo ee ku aaddan Manchester City, iyadoo aan cidna cabsi gelin karin.

item.title: Ra'iisul Wasaare Xamsa oo xilal cusub u magacaabay laba wasiir ku-xigeen oo ka tirsan xukuumadda federaalka
item.description: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa 25 November sameeyay isku shaandheyn kooban, isagoo xilal cusub u magacaabay laba xubnood oo ka tirsan xukuumadda federaalka.

item.title: Erdoğan oo Ankara ku qaabilay Khalifa Haftar, booqashadii ugu horreysay ee rasmi ah ee taliyaha bariga Liibiya
item.description: Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ayaa 25 November Aqalka Madaxtooyada ee Ankara ku qaabilay Field Marshal Khalifa Haftar, taliyaha guud ee Ciidamada Qaranka Liibiya ee bariga dalka, taas oo ah booqashadii ugu horreysay ee rasmi ah ee uu Haftar ku tago Turkiga.

item.title: Greg Fisilau oo markii ugu horreysay ka bilaabanaya England, oo shan isbeddel ku samaysay kulanka New Zealand
item.description: Xiddigga safka dambe ee Greg Fisilau ayaa markii ugu horreysay ka bilaabanaya kooxda qaranka rugby-ga England, isagoo ka mid ah shan isbeddel oo lagu sameeyay kooxda 15-ka ah ee wajahaysa New Zealand kulanka dib-u-ciyaarka ah.

item.title: Ruto iyo Steinmeier oo isku afgartay fududeynta fiisaha iyo shaqaalaynta Kenyanka u shaqo tagaya Jarmalka
item.description: Madaxweynaha Kenya William Ruto iyo dhiggiisa Jarmalka Frank-Walter Steinmeier ayaa 25 November Aqalka Madaxtooyada ee Nairobi ku isku afgartay in la fududeeyo habka fiisaha iyo shaqaalaynta Kenyanka doonaya inay ka shaqeeyaan Jarmalka.

item.title: Imaaraadka, Qatar iyo Turkiga: Soomaaliya ma goob lool-lan saameyn, mise shacabka ayaa ka faa'iidaysanaya?
item.description: Falanqayn siyaasadeed oo gaar ah oo eegaysa xiriirrada Imaaraadka Carabta, Qatar iyo Turkiga ee Soomaaliya, iyo su'aasha ah: Soomaaliya ma goob lool-lan saameyn shisheeye, mise shacabka Soomaaliyeed ayaa dhab ahaan uga faa'iidaysanaya?

item.title: Alec Bohm oo la sheegay inuu heshiis 2 sano ah oo 20 milyan oo doollar ah la galay Kansas City Royals
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka baseball-ka Alec Bohm oo ah ciyaaryahan xor ah ayaa la sheegay inuu 25 November heshiis 2 sano ah oo qiimihiisu yahay 20 milyan oo doollar la galay kooxda Kansas City Royals ee horyaalka MLB.

item.title: Salva Kiir: Hantida saliidda Koonfur Suudaan weli ma beddelin nolosha muwaadiniinta
item.description: Madaxweynaha Koonfur Suudaan Salva Kiir ayaa sheegay in hantida saliidda dalka aysan weli horumarin heerka nolosha muwaadiniinta oo dhan, wuxuuna ku baaqay in la kordhiyo wax soo saarka saliidda, la dhiso warshad sifeyn iyo in la ballaariyo helitaanka korontada.

item.title: Maalgashiga Sacuudiga ee PIF oo doonaya inuu iibiyo ilaa 25% saamiyada Newcastle si loo maalgeliyo garoon cusub
item.description: Sanduuqa Maalgashiga Dadweynaha ee Sacuudi Carabiya (PIF), oo leh kooxda Newcastle United, ayaa doonaya inuu iibiyo ilaa 25 boqolkiiba kooxda isagoo soo saaraya saamiyo cusub, si loo helo lacag lagu maalgeliyo mashaariic kaabayaal oo waaweyn.

item.title: Maxkamad Koonfur Afrika ah oo burisay go'aankii guddiga baarlamaanka ee Ramaphosa ugu hanjabay xil ka qaadis
item.description: Maxkamadda Sare ee Western Cape ayaa 25 November sheegtay in natiijooyinkii 2022 ee guddi madax-bannaan oo baarlamaanku magacaabay, kuwaas oo madaxweyne Cyril Ramaphosa ku eedeeyay is-dhexgal danaha ah oo la xiriira kiiska loo yaqaan 'Farmgate', ay ahaayeen kuwo sharci darro ah.

item.title: Federica Brignone, oo laba bilad dahab ah ku guulaysatay Olombikada, ayaa ka fariisatay tartamada barafka
item.description: Ciyaartoyda barafka ee Talyaaniga Federica Brignone, oo labo bilad dahab ah ku guulaysatay Olombikada Jiilaalka ee Milano-Cortina 2026, ayaa 25 November ku dhawaaqday inay ka fariisatay ciyaaraha tartanka, kadib markii lugteeda aysan si buuxda u bogsan.

item.title: Spalletti: Ma dhaleecayn Kolo Muani iyo Woltemade; Neto oo dib ugu soo laabanaya Juventus kulanka Omonia
item.description: Tababaraha Juventus Luciano Spalletti ayaa 25 November, isagoo ka hadlayay shir jaraa'id oo ka horreeyay kulanka Europa League ee Omonia Nicosia, sheegay inuusan waligiis dhaleecayn weeraryahannada Randal Kolo Muani iyo Nick Woltemade, isla markaana kooxdu ay soo celisay ciyaartoy dhaawacnaa.

item.title: Xasan Sheekh oo kormeeray Wasaaradda Beeraha, kuna boorriyay maalgashiga wax-soo-saarka gudaha
item.description: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Arbacada kormeer shaqo ku tegay Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Waraabka ee Muqdisho, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay mas'uuliyiinta wasaaradda iyo wakiillo ka socday beeralayda.

item.title: Crisis Group oo ugu baaqday dalalka Afrika inay xoojiyaan dadaalka xallinta xiisadda Koonfur Suudaan
item.description: Hay'adda International Crisis Group ayaa warbixin ay Talaadadii soo saartay ugu baaqday dalalka muhiimka ah ee Afrika inay taageeradooda u xoojiyaan dadaallada Midowga Afrika ee lagu xallinayo xiisadda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee Koonfur Suudaan.

item.title: Maamulaha guud ee Leicester City Kevin Davies oo xilka ka degay siddeed bilood kadib
item.description: Kevin Davies, maamulaha guud ee kooxda Leicester City, ayaa xilkiisa ka degaya siddeed bilood oo keliya kadib markii loo magacaabay.
